To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
design fiction is a useful tool to explore the relationship between social practices and domestic energy consumption.

the use of design fiction as a participatory design tool can help to identify the current limitations of a design and to envision possible design futures that can overcome these limitations, and that the use of participatory design tools in this way can be used to explore the levels of empowerment that can be achieved in sustainable design.

design fiction can be a useful tool to engage with the design for sustainability community and to identify future design directions that can help users to become empowered in their domestic energy consumption practices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to design for sustainable futures through participatory design fiction.
how design can help people to move from a state of "awareness" to a state of "empowerment" to enable sustainable energy futures.
how design can be used to support people in their transition towards a sustainable energy future.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
design fiction can be a powerful tool to identify and address design limitations in sustainable domestic energy consumption.

design fiction can be an effective and powerful tool for exploring and understanding the complex relationships between people and their environment and to identify future opportunities for design for sustainable consumption.
design fiction can be a valuable tool in participatory design for sustainable domestic energy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
design fiction can help designers and users to envision and create more sustainable futures.
we have identified a number of ways in which design fiction can be employed to help designers to explore the social and behavioural dimensions of sustainable energy futures.
design for sustainability can be re-framed by shifting from awareness to empowerment, and by shifting from behaviour towards social practices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design fiction methodology can be used to explore and identify design limitations and to propose design directions to overcome those limitations.
design fiction is an effective method to identify design challenges and to explore future design directions.
the design fiction process can help designers identify and explore new opportunities and design directions for sustainable design.
